notes: This is Papadiamantis's letters with Merlier's French notes. The polytonic letters, the dates ('Ἐν Ἀθήναις, τῇ …') and the French footnote lines all read correctly (1-4, 6-20, 21, 23-30, 32, 33, 35-40). The French language share and the digit/apostrophe flags reflect genre. One recurring blemish: superscript footnote-reference numerals at line start are labelled '✓' (3), '*' (21, 31, 34) or '·' (27), and in 5 a superscript is merged into the year ('18783' for '1873³'). The book is in the test split, so stripping a leading [✓*·] marker from labels would be a cheap clean-up, but it is not a reason to drop lines.
